messages:
morgan: Quick sync — we got the pen test report this morning. I skimmed it: top priority is the RBAC elevation vector, then incomplete KMS audit trails, and some missing audit logs for service-to-service calls. I want a short ops window this week to apply minimal RBAC fixes, export logs, and package evidence for the vendor retest. Who can own RBAC changes and who can take KMS/log exports?

alex: I can own RBAC changes. Will propose a minimal policy delta and a canary plan. timeline?

morgan: Thanks. Thinking Thu 16:00 UTC for the change window (60m). Canary on a single org/team first. We need a pre-change snapshot of policies and post-change diff for the report.

alex: Got it. I'll prepare a terraform plan and a `tf plan -out` to show the diff. plan to push to `revoked-role` branch and gate via PR.

javier: I'll take KMS audit and evidence packaging. Need clarity on which key rings to extract and how much timeframe vendor needs. Also we should preserve original ciphertext and key metadata.

morgan: Vendor asked for 30 days worth of audit logs around the exploit timestamp plus config snapshots. For KMS they want key access timeline and any asymmetric key usage.

tina: I'll handle log export. Plan to run an export to a dedicated audit bucket and provide presigned upload manifest. Will also run the live query for the suspicious timeframe and export results as ndjson.

sophia: Product side — we need to draft the customer-facing statement if there is any risk. But if this is internal RBAC hardening with no customer-facing data exposure, prefer not to escalate publicly.

morgan: Agreed. We'll keep external comms on standby. Internal remediation only for now.

alex: For the RBAC change I'm going to do a gradual rollout using one service account first. Example plan: 1) create new role with narrowed perms 2) attach to service-account-canary 3) monitor error rates for 20m 4) attach to remaining accounts.

alex: I'll post the terraform snippet in the PR. Preview: ```hcl
resource "google_project_iam_custom_role" "limited_writer" {
  role_id     = "LimitedWriter"
  title       = "Limited Writer (pen-test remediation)"
  permissions = ["storage.objects.get", "storage.objects.list"]
}
```

javier: For KMS evidence collection: I'll snapshot key metadata via `gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=prod` and collect IAM bindings for keystores. Then export Cloud Audit logs for `google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService` RPCs with: ```bash
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"' --freshness=30d --format=json > kms-audit-30d.ndjson
```

tina: On logs: I'll export the relevant service logs and the VPC flow logs. Plan to create a bucket `s3://redwood-pt-4132` (or equivalent GCS) with restricted ACLs and upload artifacts. Will provide presigned URLs for vendor to pull.

morgan: Vendor needs evidence sealed (no live edits). Let's ensure we create a checksum for each file and include a manifest. Example: `sha256sum kms-audit-30d.ndjson > kms-audit-30d.ndjson.sha256`

oncall: Heads up from oncall — if the RBAC change impacts any critical control plane, page me immediately. We'll have emergency rollback steps ready.

alex: Rollback plan will be `terraform apply` with the previous state file (I'll snapshot state and push to a protected branch). I'll also post the quick rollback snippet in the PR.

morgan: Good. One more ask: security wants continuous audit-analysis queries run after changes to ensure no unexpected access. Tina, can you schedule a watch query for 6 hours post-change and post alerts into #eng-oncall if we see elevated denied->granted errors?

tina: Yep. I'll create a logging-based metric and an alert policy. Quick snippet for the log-based metric: ```
resource.type="gce_instance" AND protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND severity!="INFO"
```

javier: For evidence packaging, vendor requires the following per item: file, checksum, export command, and who executed it. I'll create a small README in the bucket with that metadata and store signatures from the operator (PGP fingerprint) to prove authenticity.

sophia: One more angle — compliance wants to know if KMS keys used for customer data were rotated or rewrapped during evidence collection. Javier — confirm no rewraps or key rotations during the window or log them if they occur.

javier: Will ensure zero touching of keys. If we must rotate, it'll be scheduled after evidence snapshot and captured in the manifest.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: RBAC patch PR -> merged at 2024-09-12T16:00:00Z -> canary attach -> monitor 20m -> roll rest.

alex: I'll link the PR here once ready. ETA for PR: today EOD.

morgan: Thanks team. Final checklist before Thu:
- alex: PR + terraform plan + rollback state (owner: alex)
- javier: KMS snapshots + audit log export + manifest (owner: javier)
- tina: log exports + alert metric + bucket and presigned links (owner: tina)
- oncall: standby for paging if rollout breaks (owner: oncall)
- sophia: hold comms draft (owner: sophia)

morgan: If you can all react with :thumbsup: once you accept the owners and timeline, I'll lock the window and invite the vendor for the retest slot.

alex: :thumbsup:

javier: :thumbsup: will start KMS list now

tina: :thumbsup: prepping export job

sophia: :thumbsup: draft ready

oncall: :thumbsup: on standby

morgan: Great — I'll finalize calendar invite and PR reviewers. We'll keep this thread for updates and the final artifact manifests.
